lane_specific_ingestion_rules.rule: corrections touching Interslavic/Panslavic text may require Latin and Cyrillic updates plus sidecar validation
CJK line breaking and formula association must be visually checked after accepted prose edits
regional variants should be recorded as variants when valid
script mix, particles, and formula punctuation need visual inspection after edits
fa_IR, prs_AF, and tg_Cyrl_TJ corrections must not transfer across sublanes without explicit authority
RTL directionality, punctuation, and formula embedding require visual checks after accepted edits
language-community or project-authority correction is distinct from mathematical-register correction
